name: Indes UI Themes
description: Indic regional and architectural UI design token themes calibrated across paired light and dark modes.

themes.name: Gangotri Dark
themes.description: Glacial whites, crisp slate blues, and granite bedrock inspired by the sacred Himalayan river source in Uttarakhand. (Dark Mode UI)

themes.name: Gangotri Light
themes.description: Glacial whites, crisp slate blues, and granite bedrock inspired by the sacred Himalayan river source in Uttarakhand. (Light Mode UI)

themes.name: Bhirrana Light
themes.description: Bronze-age ash greys, baked silt, and earthen tones drawn from one of the oldest Indus Valley settlements in Haryana. (Light Mode UI)
